import os
import math
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw

def draw_frame(frame_index):
    # 1. Frame size: 1920x1080
    # 2. Background color MUST be neon green (#00FF00)
    width, height = 1920, 1080
    img = Image.new('RGB', (width, height), '#00FF00')
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    
    # Draw blackboard
    board_rect = [150, 150, 1200, 850]
    draw.rectangle(board_rect, fill='#222222', outline='#555555', width=15)
    # Chalk drawings (some random math / lines)
    draw.line([250, 300, 500, 300], fill='white', width=4)
    draw.line([250, 350, 400, 350], fill='white', width=4)
    draw.line([250, 500, 300, 400], fill='white', width=4)
    draw.line([300, 400, 450, 400], fill='white', width=4)
    draw.ellipse([600, 300, 800, 500], outline='white', width=4)
    draw.line([600, 400, 800, 400], fill='white', width=4)
    draw.line([700, 300, 700, 500], fill='white', width=4)
    
    # Stickman properties
    head_cx, head_cy = 1450, 350
    head_r = 70
    
    # Animation variables
    # i goes from 0 to 89
    i = frame_index - 361
    
    # Aggressive pointing math
    # Fast striking motion every ~15 frames
    cycle = i % 15
    if cycle < 5:
        # striking down
        strike_prog = cycle / 5.0
        hand_y = 450 + 150 * strike_prog
        hand_x = 1250 - 50 * strike_prog
    else:
        # recovering up
        strike_prog = (cycle - 5) / 10.0
        hand_y = 600 - 150 * strike_prog
        hand_x = 1200 + 50 * strike_prog
    
    # Stickman body
    draw.ellipse([head_cx - head_r, head_cy - head_r, head_cx + head_r, head_cy + head_r], outline='black', width=10, fill='white')
    
    # Angry face
    eye_offset_x = 25
    eye_offset_y = -10
    draw.ellipse([head_cx - eye_offset_x - 5, head_cy + eye_offset_y - 5, head_cx - eye_offset_x + 5, head_cy + eye_offset_y + 5], fill='black')
    draw.ellipse([head_cx + eye_offset_x - 5, head_cy + eye_offset_y - 5, head_cx + eye_offset_x + 5, head_cy + eye_offset_y + 5], fill='black')
    
    # Angry eyebrows ( \ / )
    draw.line([head_cx - eye_offset_x - 20, head_cy + eye_offset_y - 25, head_cx - eye_offset_x + 10, head_cy + eye_offset_y - 10], fill='black', width=6)
    draw.line([head_cx + eye_offset_x + 20, head_cy + eye_offset_y - 25, head_cx + eye_offset_x - 10, head_cy + eye_offset_y - 10], fill='black', width=6)
    
    # Strict mouth (upside down U or just straight)
    draw.line([head_cx - 20, head_cy + 30, head_cx + 20, head_cy + 30], fill='black', width=6)
    draw.line([head_cx - 20, head_cy + 30, head_cx - 30, head_cy + 40], fill='black', width=6)
    draw.line([head_cx + 20, head_cy + 30, head_cx + 30, head_cy + 40], fill='black', width=6)
    
    # Body
    shoulder_y = head_cy + head_r
    pelvis_y = shoulder_y + 250
    draw.line([head_cx, shoulder_y, head_cx, pelvis_y], fill='black', width=10)
    
    # Legs
    draw.line([head_cx, pelvis_y, head_cx - 100, pelvis_y + 200], fill='black', width=10)
    draw.line([head_cx, pelvis_y, head_cx + 100, pelvis_y + 200], fill='black', width=10)
    
    # Right Arm (Hand on hip)
    draw.line([head_cx, shoulder_y + 20, head_cx + 80, shoulder_y + 100], fill='black', width=10)
    draw.line([head_cx + 80, shoulder_y + 100, head_cx + 20, pelvis_y], fill='black', width=10)
    
    # Left Arm (Pointing aggressively with stick)
    draw.line([head_cx, shoulder_y + 20, hand_x, hand_y], fill='black', width=10)
    
    # Stick
    stick_length = 500
    # stick direction: pointing towards blackboard (left and slightly up/down)
    stick_end_x = hand_x - stick_length
    stick_end_y = hand_y - (hand_y - 300) * 1.5 # magnify the motion
    draw.line([hand_x, hand_y, stick_end_x, stick_end_y], fill='#8B4513', width=15) # brown stick
    
    return img

def main():
    output_dir = r"C:\Users\renu5\Downloads\stickman_master_asset"
    os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
    
    for i in range(361, 451):
        img = draw_frame(i)
        filename = f"frame_{i}.png"
        filepath = os.path.join(output_dir, filename)
        img.save(filepath)
        print(f"Saved {filepath}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
